content.thinking: Toronto's regular gasoline was cheaper than Vancouver's in September 2026, at 183.7 versus 209.5 cents per litre, a gap of 25.8 cents. I'm taking the unit from the table's convention, since the tool result only said "units".

input.answer: Toronto was cheaper in September 2026. Regular unleaded self-serve gasoline averaged 183.7 cents/litre in Toronto versus 209.5 cents/litre in Vancouver, a gap of 209.5 − 183.7 = 25.8 cents/litre. The unit (cents per litre) is the table's convention; the tool result only said "units".
